memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks unaided, reports mild fatigue.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal).
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; TUG 10 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular
Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Denies low mood, reports occasional anxiety.
carers: Main carer Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to stay active and manage my kidney health."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: telmisartan 40 mg OD; dapagliflozin 10 mg OD; furosemide 20 mg OD; sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD; melatonin 3 mg HS; trazodone 50 mg HS.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (0.6-1.2); eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60); urine albumin-creatinine ratio 85 mg/g (<30); haemoglobin 11.8 g/dL (12-16); TSH 2.1 µIU/mL (0.4-4.0); Insomnia Severity Index score 10 (0-28).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: ADL independence maintained, occasional shortness of breath on exertion.
cognition: Mini-Cog not repeated (annual due next visit).
falls: One fall at home 3 months ago, no injury; gait slightly unsteady; TUG 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise exercise and supportive footwear.
medicines: 7 regular
Polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: Reports low mood two days/week, denies hopelessness.
carers: Main carer Priya, daughter.
goals: "I wish to stay mobile and avoid further falls."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: ADL independence with mild fatigue, walks with cane outdoors.

mood: Improved mood, reports better sleep.
carers: Main carer Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to keep my mind sharp and stay independent."
